context: An elderly couple discusses old friends
purpose: Teach: 和田/小野/阿部/内田/西村/太田/前田/永田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 同期会の名簿、和田くん、小野くん、今も連絡取れる。
lines.en: Class reunion roster — Wada, Ono — I can still reach them.
lines.style: Slow, measured pace. Gentle remembrance in the voice. Gaze turned inward, fingers perhaps following names on a page. Warmth threaded through without sentiment.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 阿部さん、内田さん、今年は喪中だったわね。
lines.en: Abe, Uchida — they're both in mourning this year.
lines.style: Quieter register. A respectful pause before their names. No heaviness, just recognition. Voice settles naturally, like delivering sad news that's been absorbed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 西村くんは、地元の世話役を引き受けてる。
lines.en: Nishimura took on the role of local organizer.
lines.style: Approving nod in the tone. Steady, even rhythm. Acknowledgment of responsibility well-placed. Light lift on 「引き受けてる」— genuine regard for the choice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 太田さんと前田さんは、温泉旅行誘ってくれたの。
lines.en: Ota and Maeda invited us both to a hot spring getaway.
lines.style: Lighter here. A small smile behind the words. Pitch lifts slightly — a touch of pleasure in being thought of. Easy, almost conspiratorial warmth with his wife.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 永田くん、入院したらしい。お見舞いに行こう。
lines.en: Nagata's been hospitalized, it seems. We should go visit.
lines.style: Shift to quiet resolve. Opening word carries weight — the pivot from pleasant news to necessary one. Steady conviction without drama. "Let's" lands as both suggestion and gentle request.
